morluto-rea-agents-rea-analysis-optimiza.description: Optimize REA providers and shared analysis workflows for agent context, latency, CPU, and memory while preserving correctness and Evidence. Use for analysis bottlenecks and cache or query design; CI/test-suite optimization belongs to rea-ci-tests-audit.

morluto-rea-agents-rea-changelog-update.description: Prepare or rewrite REA release changelogs and GitHub release notes from pinned Git history, with verified contributor thanks and Release Please synchronization.

morluto-rea-agents-rea-ci-tests-audit.description: Audit REA CI and test suites for correctness, fixture drift, false passes, and measured performance; use for suite or workflow investigations and efficiency changes, rather than ordinary feature testing or a single test failure.

morluto-rea-agents-rea-tool-design.description: Design or change REA investigation tools, CLI/MCP contracts, provider capabilities, and Evidence semantics.

morluto-rea-agents-reverse-engineer-anyt.description: Reverse engineer native, managed, Electron/JavaScript, packaged, firmware, and browser targets with REA. Use shipped-artifact or requested runtime evidence to explain features, compare versions, decompile code, or guide a reconstruction. Skip REA for ordinary source-repository architecture analysis.
